notes.subject: נעמת
notes.rationale: 'Art thou more pleasant/lovely than whom?' — some read 'more beautiful', others 'more agreeable'; the taunt questions Egypt's superiority.

notes.subject: Eġittu
notes.rationale: Direct mocking address to Egypt in the second person feminine.

notes.subject: dawk li m'humiex maqtugħa
notes.rationale: ערלים is literally 'uncircumcised ones', the mark of shame among the dead; rendered descriptively.

translation: Minn min inti inqas mill-oħrajn? Inżel, u tinxħet ⟨את⟩ ma' dawk li m'humiex maqtugħa.
